title: Wring a strep-test swab: squeeze the tube on the head, turn 5 times, wait a minute, draw it out under a moving squeeze
instruction: Do the strep test's swab step: put the swab head down to the bottom of the tube, squeeze the tube on the head and turn the swab 5 times, leave it in the tube for 1 minute, then take the swab out while squeezing the tube on the head and turning, drop it in the bin, let go of the tube and move both hands away.
context: Medical assistants (O*NET 31-9092.00) list as a Core task 'Perform routine laboratory tests and sample analyses.' A CLIA-waived rapid strep A test is one, run in clinics daily. Its insert (ACON Flowflex Plus Strep A, FDA CLIA waiver CW250006) gives the swab step: 'Rotate swab 5 times while squeezing, keep swab in test tube for 1 minute, and remove swab while rotating and squeezing the tube before testing extracted material.' The squeeze wrings the sample out of the swab head into the buffer. The count of five is given: the difficulty is in the hands. One hand keeps the soft tube squeezed on the head at the tube's bottom while the other turns the 3 mm swab against the pinched walls, regripping for each stroke without pulling it out. After the minute the head is drawn out, turning, with the tube squeezed on it wherever it is: a squeeze dents the tube only under the fingers, so that hand follows the head up. In the demo the left hand works the swab, the right squeezes.
setup: Two YAM arms at the near edge of a table; positions are (x forward from the arm bases, y left) in cm, heights above the table. Tube holder (steel, painted): a block 4 x 4 x 2.5 cm at (28, 8) with a 14 mm socket 10 mm deep. Extraction tube: translucent polyethylene, 75 mm long, 13 mm across, 10 mm bore, standing upright in the holder with its bottom 1.5 cm above the table, so its 65 mm above the socket are free to squeeze; a squeeze about a finger wide with about 3 N dents it onto the swab head there only, up to 4.5 mm on each side. Throat swab: 15 cm long, a 3 mm polystyrene shaft with a blue tab on one side 3 cm from its end and a 2 mm blue depth band 64 mm from the head's tip, and a flocked head 5 mm across and 20 mm long; 8 g. It lies on the test kit's box along y, its head tip at (20, 25), its handle 5 cm over the box's edge. Kit box: card, 10 x 10 x 5 cm, centred at (20, 20). Waste bin: an open polypropylene box 12 x 12 x 8 cm, centred at (7, 20). Friction: wet swab on wet tube about 0.1 to 0.3; gripper pads on the swab about 0.3. Real trials only, not in the simulation: a side camera (a phone on a stand) level with the tube's middle, 30 cm beyond it at about (58, 8), looking back along -x, across the squeeze.
scoring: Read from video. The head is squeezed when the tube's sides are pressed in onto it (2.3 to 3.4 mm on both sides) over at least 5 mm of its 20 mm length. A turn counts while the head is squeezed with its tip within 10 mm of the tube's bottom; turns back count against it. 0.12 per full turn, 0.6 at 5 turns. 0.7 when, after 5 turns, the swab has stayed in the tube with its head at the bottom for 1 minute in a row (lifted early, the minute starts again). 0.8 when, after the minute, the head is drawn from the bottom up and out of the tube rising only while squeezed (in the tube it may stand at most 1 mm above the highest point it reached squeezed, and rise no faster than 60 mm/s), turned at least 0.15 turn during the draw while squeezed; a head that rises otherwise must go back to the bottom and start again (the minute is not repeated). 1.0 when, after that, the swab is in the bin (its middle inside the walls) with every fingertip at least 5 cm from the tube and from the whole swab, held 1 s. 0 if the swab falls off the table. Real trial: the side camera and the station's top camera film the trial. Depth: the depth band's lower edge at or below the tube's top edge (under its rim ring) means the tip is within 10 mm of the bottom. The squeeze: on the side camera the fingers' pads press the tube's sides in at the head's height (the head shows through the translucent wall), over at least 5 mm of it, at every frame the head rises. Turns are counted from the blue tab; the minute is timed on the video clock from the end of the fifth turn to the start of the draw.
reset_notes: Put a fresh tube with buffer in the holder and a fresh swab on the box in the start pose; empty the bin. The swab and the buffer are used up each trial.
fidelity: Rigid bodies at 240 Hz on GPU. The tube is fixed in its holder; its two walls across the squeeze are soft, each 8 sprung 9 mm segments (0.25 N/mm, 4.5 mm travel), so a squeeze dents it only under the fingers, in steps where a real dent is smooth. The buffer and sample are not simulated; a turn counts while the squeezed segments bear on the head. The minute is timed. The tube is drawn opaque. The swab weighs 8 g, not 1 to 2 g, for steady contact.
